'''Armor-piercing warheads''' were a specific type of [[Warhead/Legends|warhead]] utilized by [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] and [[Concussion bomb/Legends|concussion bombs]]. The warhead contained a compact energy pack that released concussive blastwaves upon detonation. The explosive force disrupted instruments and equipment in addition to causing shock and blast damage.<ref name="SWS" /> [[Concussion missile/Legends|Concussion missiles]] such as the [[ST2 concussion missile/Legends|ST2 concussion missile]] was equippped with an armor-piercing warhead.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
